answer: What survives to the prism is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lagoon. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short.
